title: O3K Native Topology Failure Domain v1
description: Contract for the native topology failure-domain API (`/o3k/v1/topology/failure-domains`): the canonical failure-domain document (exactly the kernel FailureDomain serialization), create/update request bodies, and the bounded page envelope. O3K is the single authority for location topology; no provider, host, hypervisor, cluster, Ceph pool, storage backend, or network-controller identity is representable here.

class.description: Coarseness class of the failure domain (kebab-case); immutable after creation.

name.description: Human-readable display name; the only mutable label besides metadata.

metadata.description: Bounded key/value annotations; keys match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]*$ (1..=64), values are at most 256 characters.

parent.description: Parent failure domain, if any; immutable after creation and always within the same availability domain.

generation.description: Optimistic-concurrency generation; starts at 1 and increments on every successful update.

updateRequest.description: Mutable fields only; `id`, `class`, `availability_domain`, and `parent` are immutable after creation. Requires the `If-Match: generation-N` precondition.

next_cursor.description: Opaque HMAC-authenticated keyset continuation; present exactly when `has_more` is true.
